title: Choosing Activities at the Community Centre
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创阅读材料（模拟练习，非官方雅思测试）。请先阅读短文，然后完成8道题。题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。注意第三人称单数、do/does问答、like、can/cannot以及and/but的用法。
passage: The Westside Community Centre opens at 9 a.m. every day. It has many activities for people. Tom likes the cooking class. He goes to the cooking class on Monday. He can make simple cakes, but he cannot make bread. His sister, Lily, likes the art class. She draws pictures on Tuesday. She can draw animals, but she cannot draw people. Their friend, Ben, likes the music class. He sings songs on Wednesday. He can play the guitar, but he cannot play the piano. The centre also has a chess club. It meets on Friday. Many people like chess. The centre is a happy place.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数、do/does问答、like、can/cannot、and/but
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，当主语是第三人称单数（he, she, it）时，动词一般要加-s或-es。例如：like变成likes，go变成goes，draw变成draws。否定句和疑问句要用does，并且后面的动词用原形。例如：He likes the class. 变成疑问句：Does he like the class? 否定句：He does not like the class. can表示能力，后面直接跟动词原形，否定是cannot。and表示并列，but表示转折。
grammar.example: Tom likes the cooking class. He goes to the cooking class on Monday. He can make simple cakes, but he cannot make bread.
